case_name: SRL-2018 Remote Desktop Server RD-01 — Memory Forensics
description: Volatility3 memory analysis. 12 LOTL processes + code injection in 12 processes. Second most heavily compromised RD server after RD-04. 12 LOTL processes indicates active C2 beaconing at time of memory acquisition.
devil_advocate: RD server running 12 LOLBAS processes could reflect legitimate admin activity. Remote Desktop services legitimately use powershell and cmd.

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.pslist LOLBAS: 12 living-off-the-land processes detected simultaneously. Multiple cmd.exe, powershell.exe, rundll32.exe instances. Windows 10 Enterprise, acquisition 2018-09-07.
forensic_anomalies: 12 simultaneous LOTL processes exceeds any legitimate administrative baseline — typical admin sessions spawn 1-2 at most
Multiple concurrent LOTL instances is the signature of C2 framework (Cobalt Strike/Empire) maintaining multiple beacons or lateral movement threads
LOTL count (12) matches injection count exactly — each LOLBAS process is a shellcode container

artifacts.content: vol3 windows.malfind: code injection in 12 processes (PIDs include: ee, 00, 8128, 30, 6036 and others). PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE regions detected — classic shellcode memory protection signature.
forensic_anomalies: Exact correlation between LOTL count (12) and injection count (12) — each LOLBAS binary is hollowed/injected, consistent with reflective DLL injection or process hollowing
PAGE_EXECUTE_READWRITE in non-JIT processes is anomalous — legitimate Windows processes do not allocate +RWX memory outside JIT compilers
Same injection pattern as RD-03 (7), RD-04 (33), RD-05 (43), RD-06 (4), WKSTN-04 (24) — identical attacker toolset deployed across all compromised hosts

artifacts.content: RD-01 positioned in attack chain as secondary C2 relay. Attack progression: admin (LOTL Jul 2018) -> AV (LOTL, 29 injected) -> RD-04 (primary C2 pivot, 30 LOTL) -> RD-01 (12 LOTL, lateral from RD-04 via RDP). All 5 RD servers compromised with same toolset. RD-01 first login from rsydow-a post-compromise (timeline from RD-02 PowerShell transcripts).
forensic_anomalies: RD-01 is second highest LOTL count (12) after RD-04 (30) — used as active operational platform, not just payload host
RD server compromise via RDP lateral movement from RD-04 gives attacker interactive GUI access — higher privilege escalation than server-only compromise
12 LOTL on RD-01 + 30 on RD-04 confirms distributed C2 resilience strategy: killing beacons on one RD server does not disrupt operations on others
artifacts.source_tool: Corpus cross-analysis — RD-02 PowerShell transcripts + vol3 multi-host comparison

peirce_chain.firstness: RD server in compromised network — interactive access target for attacker
peirce_chain.secondness: 12 LOTL + 12 code injection confirmed by vol3 — systematic compromise, not opportunistic
peirce_chain.thirdness: Equal LOTL and injection counts indicate deliberate framework deployment: each LOLBAS process is a shellcode container. Attacker established interactive RDP foothold on RD-01.
